```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats continue to support the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to continuing space exploration and discovery.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in continuing the spirit of discovery that has animated NASA's human space exploration, in addition to its scientific and medical research, technological innovation, and educational mission that allows us to better understand our own planet and place in the universe.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strengthen support for the United States' role in space through continued presence on the International Space Station, working in partnership with the international community to continue scientific and medical innovation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support NASA's work to return Americans to the moon and go beyond to Mars, taking the next step in exploring our solar system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats additionally support strengthening NASA and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's Earth observation missions to better understand how climate change is impacting our home planet.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
